arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 8 km, 8 legs of 1 km. Steer by the pod (shaft power, w_bal_pod_frac); boat-speed reserve mixes in current/drag. Target shaft power about sustainable_shaft_power_w (~170 W, CP shaft 165). Start was hard (232 W). Let them settle; cue only if still well above sustainable after minute 2-3. Watches set: pod_reserve_low, drag_or_current (push_local below -0.2 for 30 s: check rudder/weed vs current; on out-and-back, current flips each leg), effort_sag, final_push_window at 1200 m. CP may be 10-25 pct off: check cp_implied later.
